name: Ricardo Álvarez
bio:
Ricardo's motorsport journey began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his uncle's auto repair shop in Buenos Aires. His keen eye for detail quickly became apparent, leading him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, Ricardo landed a role at a local racing team, where he honed his skills in quality control, ensuring that every component met the highest standards. 

Ricardo is known for his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to perfection. He believes that even the smallest flaw can have a significant impact on performance, and he leaves no stone unturned in his quest for excellence. His dedication and experience have made him a valuable asset to the Peugeot TotalEnergies team, where he plays a crucial role in maintaining the reliability and performance of their racing vehicles. Ricardo's innovative ideas have also improved testing procedures at Peugeot.

physical.description: A man of medium build, Ricardo's serious gaze reflects his intense focus.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Insists on personally inspecting every component before it's installed.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
